name: Coyote
summary: Bluffing elimination game where each player wears an unseen feather and bids on the total value of all feathers.
rules_text: Each player wears a bandana with a feather whose value they cannot see but all others can. Feathers are drawn from a shuffled deck; some are positive, negative, or blue specials that modify the total. Starting player declares a total for all feathers in play. Clockwise each player must either declare a strictly higher total or call Coyote. When Coyote is called the round ends, all feathers are revealed and summed: add positives, subtract negatives, then apply blue cards in order (add top of deck, discard highest positive, turn highest positive negative, double positives, zero forces reshuffle). If the true total is less than the last declaration, that declarer loses; otherwise the caller loses. Loser takes a coyote token. Three tokens eliminates a player. Survivors draw new unseen feathers and the player who did not lose starts the next round. Last player remaining wins.
rating_reason: Hidden own feather guessing game, bluffing, sequential guessing, fits engine
reasons:
